surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: The Wild beat the Blue Jackets
paras: Danila Yurov opened the scoring for the Wild late in the first. Adam Fantilli tied it 1-1 for Columbus a minute later, but that’s where Columbus’ luck ran out. Kirill Kaprizov put the Wild ahead for good on the power play early in the second, with Joel Eriksson Ek picking up his 200th NHL assist on the assist.

The Wild earned this one. Replay the chances a hundred times and they win about seven in ten. Jesper Wallstedt made 13 saves for the Wild, and Cam Talbot, who gave up six goals against Florida in his last start, stopped 32 of 34.
The Blue Jackets killed off a two-man advantage that lasted just under two minutes early in the first. The Wild improved to 6-2-1, and the Jackets fell to 3-4-0.
